name: 4-coil Shakti: amygdala left + slow hippocampus right (30 min)
summary: Murphy's stereo Shakti session with his alternative 'slow' hippocampal signal on the right temporal lobe and the amygdala signal on the left. Murphy calls the slow signal 'more experimental than the Standard Hippocampal signal' and reports two men 'being energized' by it. Its timing is not published; the slowing played here is this project's own choice.
setting: Evenings: the vendor says sessions are 'usually better after the sun goes down'. Darkness and quiet (the vendor says effects during a session need darkness and silence); eyes closed, relaxed, without meditating or falling asleep; no meditation, mind machines or drugs at the same time.
schedule: Vendor's Shakti rules: at most every 72 h or once a week, never on consecutive days; a series of 3 or 6 sessions, then a 21-day break.
notes: Of his slow hippocampal signal Murphy says only that 'the duration of the bursts of output are different, as well as the length of time between the bursts' ('About the Hippocampal signal'). Played here on the right: the project's primed burst (one pulse, then four pulses, three times; after Tsang 2004 p.5 [1017]) on 4-ms points instead of 3, so the four pulses come 228 ms after the single pulse and a train lasts 0.99 s, then 4 s of silence. The 4-ms points and the 4-s silence are the project's choice. Read like the vendor's other file names, its name ltp_24_16 would mean 16-ms points and 24 ms between signals, an unconfirmed reading. The amygdala burst is the project's rising sweep, 6 to 30 Hz, at the lab's burst length of 230 points (Ryczko 2002 p.1 [592], p.2 [593]) of 3 ms, 0.69 s. Both sides play at once and drift against each other; the vendor does not say how the two are timed. Coils: FT7 and TP7 on the left, FT8 and TP8 on the right, each pair one (+) and one (-) coil, as in every Shakti unit. The sites are the project's reading: the vendor's 4-coil photo shows one coil above the other. Field strength: Tsang 2004 gives about 1 uT near the scalp on the left and 0.5 uT on the right (p.5-6 [1017-1018]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT that is about 24 uT at the scalp on both sides, 24 and 48 times Tsang's figures. Support: the vendor's testimonials. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). One negative report followed sessions longer than suggested: keep to 30 min. Murphy reports headache or pressure in about 2% of users of an earlier version, mostly with hippocampal signals; if so, lower the intensity by one third. Not for people with epilepsy; stop at once if distressed.
